verdicts.reason: A: the FIZZBANG logo pill sits on top of a busy pink, yellow and blue shape cluster crammed into the left corner. The headline breaks to leave 'can' alone on its own line, and the CTA is tiny and hard to read at 320x50; most of the pop-art graphics and the white card are gone. B has the same orphaned 'can' and a logo that is clipped against the left edge over the busy shapes, but its headline and CTA are bigger and more legible, and the left-to-right banner reading order is cleaner, so it is slightly less bad.
